footer.contentDescription: The public reference platform for defining, designing, building, deploying, operating and evolving Astoria's public digital infrastructure.

hero.title: Build public digital technology.
hero.lead: We support Astoria's public administrations to make stronger use of open standards and shared digital commons, back the publication and pooling of source code, and build ties with the open-source ecosystem.

doors.title: Standards <accent>for</accent> and <accent>by</accent> public administrations, <accent>with</accent> the agents 🧢

forAdmin.title: For public administrations
forAdmin.desc: Learn about and use the recommended standards and references in your information systems.

byAdmin.title: By public administrations
byAdmin.desc: Publish your source code under a free licence and explore what other administrations publish.

community.title: The community
community.desc: Enrich exchanges between public agents and contributors of Astoria's digital commons.

band.title: The open-source and digital commons pole
band.text: The open-source and digital commons pole supports Astoria's public administrations throughout the lifecycle of their digital services. On CODE.GOUV.AOR it publishes the open standards, methods, components and source code that structure public digital technology — to use them, share them and evolve them together.

standard.question: Are you a public agent and want to propose a standard for public digital technology?
standard.answer: Every change to the shared standards starts with a public proposal: open your <link>RFC</link> and take part in the discussion.

repositories.question: Are you a public administration and want to publish or reference your source code?
repositories.answer: Follow the <link>Open Source</link> guide to publish your code under a free licence and reference your organisation's repositories in the public inventory.

events.question: Do you want to propose a meetup, share feedback or join the community?
events.answer: Head to the <link>Community</link> page to find the exchange spaces and events around Astoria's digital commons.

follow.newsletterText: Latest RFCs, component releases and published standards: follow the platform's life on its public repository.

explore.title: Explore the platform

lifecycle.title: How to build <accent>public</accent> digital technology
